text:
Divine mouth filled with sweetness,

        happy the lip that kisses and touches you,

        for among all that exist there is no mouth so sweet,

        nor chain so fit to imprison me.


        Not the tasty honeycomb of the hive

        provokes such pleasure and softness,

        for sweetness is in you, and yours diminishes

        amber, carnation, and lily.


        But hidden inside the honey

        is the cruel sting with which you wound me,

        and no one sees this sign of life;


        tender mouth and hardened breast,

        no, nor ever among all women,

        a mouth so soft and a heart so worthy.

translation.title: To a Lady's Kiss
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the kiss as honeyed chain with a hidden sting.
